{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/subtasks/copper_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching_trial_1/npt_relax.in", "content": "# NPT relaxation of Copper structure

units metal
atom_style atomic

pair_style eam/alloy

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Set timestep

# Setup temperature and pressure compute
compute myTemp all temp
compute myPress all pressure myTemp

# NPT dynamics with Nose-Hoover thermostat and barostat
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 100 iso 0 0 1000

# Run NPT relaxation
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density pe ke etotal
dump 1 all custom 10000 dump.lammpstrj id type x y z

run 10000

# Write final structure
write_data relaxed_structure.data

print "Final density = $(density) g/cm^3""}
